threat_summary: Fake CAPTCHA pages copy a PowerShell download cradle to the clipboard and instruct the victim to paste it into Win+R. Recursive unpacking of the stager resolved two second-stage C2 domains not yet flagged by AV vendors.

internal_hunting_tasks.description: RunMRU values containing a LOLBin plus a download/decode token (Sysmon 13).
internal_hunting_tasks.sigma_yaml:
title: ClickFix - Suspicious Command Pasted Into Run Dialog (RunMRU)
id: 6c9a3f0e-2d41-4b8e-9a51-0f3d6f2b7c11
status: experimental
description: Detects RunMRU values written when a user pastes a download-and-execute command into Win+R.
author: OutSight HuntCompiler
date: 2026-10-30
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: registry_set
detection:
  selection_key:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\RunMRU'
  selection_lolbin:
    Details|contains:
      - 'mshta'
      - 'powershell'
      - 'pwsh'
      - 'cmd /c'
      - 'curl'
  selection_payload:
    Details|contains:
      - 'http'
      - ' -enc'
      - ' -e '
      - 'iwr'
      - 'irm'
      - 'iex'
      - 'frombase64string'
  condition: selection_key and selection_lolbin and selection_payload
falsepositives:
  - Administrators pasting legitimate one-liners into Win+R
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.004
  - attack.t1059.001

query_string.query: data.win.system.eventID:13 AND (data.win.eventdata.targetObject:*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\RunMRU* AND (data.win.eventdata.details:(*mshta* OR *powershell* OR *pwsh* OR *cmd\ \/c* OR *curl*)) AND (data.win.eventdata.details:(*http* OR *\ \-enc* OR *\ \-e\ * OR *iwr* OR *irm* OR *iex* OR *frombase64string*)))

internal_hunting_tasks.description: explorer.exe spawning a script host with a download cradle (Sysmon 1).
internal_hunting_tasks.sigma_yaml:
title: ClickFix - Script Host Spawned Directly by Explorer With Download Cradle
id: 0b6f5f0a-8f0e-4d3e-b7a4-2c4b1d9e5a37
status: experimental
description: Explorer launching a script host with a download/decode cradle is the execution step of a Win+R ClickFix lure.
author: OutSight HuntCompiler
date: 2026-10-30
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'http'
      - ' -enc'
      - 'iwr'
      - 'irm'
      - 'iex'
      - 'frombase64string'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Admin one-liners launched from the Run dialog
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.004
  - attack.t1218.005

query_string.query: data.win.system.eventID:1 AND (data.win.eventdata.parentImage:*\\explorer.exe AND (data.win.eventdata.image:(*\\mshta.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\wscript.exe)) AND (data.win.eventdata.commandLine:(*http* OR *\ \-enc* OR *iwr* OR *irm* OR *iex* OR *frombase64string*)))

suggested_remediation: Block the listed domains on DNS/proxy for the TTL window.
On a sighting: isolate the host, collect the PowerShell/mshta command line and reset the user's sessions.
